scope.importantLimit: Every move has execution and AI smoke coverage, not an exhaustive proof of every move/ability/item/field interaction.

changes: Return/Frustration and other variable-power attacks receive the same known-immunity penalty as fixed-power attacks; reactive Counter/Mirror Coat/Metal Burst/Bide stay exempt until an incoming hypothesis is projected.
Shared conditional damage powers for HP, major statuses, item absence, current-turn damage and order; real engine and private AI copies aligned.

Foul Play borrows opposing Attack/stages, while attacking ability/item modifiers belong to its user. Psyshock/Psystrike/Secret Sword use Defense; Sacred Sword/Chip Away ignore defensive/evasion stages.
Critical hits ignore unfavorable offensive and favorable defensive stages; Frost Breath/Storm Throw and guaranteed-critical predictions fixed; minimum positive damage is 1 HP.

Freeze-Dry/Flying Press type matchups shared with the ability immunity gate and planner. Hidden Power uses own IV parity, exposes its current type on battle buttons, and only reveals an opposing type after observation.

Dream Eater, Focus Punch, Synchronoise, Last Resort and Belch preconditions checked, with normal PP cost. Used-move history is bounded by the current four moves; berry eating persists through switching only within this battle.
Growth sunlight and Acupressure available-stat selection fixed; Smelling Salts/Wake-Up Slap cure after a real HP hit, not through a substitute.
OHKO level/Sheer Cold restrictions and accuracy rules aligned; no accuracy/evasion/Compound Eyes/Gravity boost. No Guard/Lock-On do not override the level clause; AI predicts damage and Sturdy.

Jump Kick corrected from 130 to 100 power. Both jump kicks lose half max HP after a real failed attempt (miss, immunity, Protect, unreachable target), without crashing during sleep/paralysis or a rejected selection; Magic Guard preserved.

Natural Gift berry types/powers and Fling item powers corrected on 60 existing item definitions; item stat/damage boosts removed before the throw. Prices, item ownership, shops and ordinary effects unchanged.
French Return/Frustration descriptions now state the existing fixed 102 power adaptation; generated learning/details references remain synchronized.

audit.scope: Structural coverage and execution smoke checks; behavioral rules are tested separately.

beforePatchReplay.note: Old modules and both old catalogues loaded in memory in an isolated process; no production source/service was replaced. Only matching semantic tests selected, no missing-new-API errors.
